speakerRequired.title: Speaker Required
speakerRequired.subtitle: Connect to a Sonos speaker to configure audio and sound settings.

tvAutoplay.title: TV Autoplay
tvAutoplay.reading: Reading the current setting from the speaker…

off.label: OFF
off.description: Sonos stays on the current music. TV audio only plays when you select it yourself.

on.label: ON
on.description: Sonos automatically switches to TV audio when any audio signal is detected on the TV input — including Android TV interface sounds.

smart.label: SMART
smart.description: Turns off when you open this app and back on when you leave it, so interface sounds can't interrupt your music.

tvAutoplay.tip: Tip: If TV navigation clicks keep stopping your music, choose {{smart}} — TV Autoplay turns off when you open this app and back on when you leave it.

loudness.title: Loudness
loudness.description: Boosts certain frequencies at lower volumes to produce a fuller, balanced sound

nightMode.title: Night Mode
nightMode.description: Compresses audio dynamic range for quiet late-night listening

speech.title: Speech Enhancement
speech.description: Boosts dialogue clarity and center voice channels for TV sound

ungroup.title: Ungroup on Autoplay
ungroup.description: Automatically drop this room from music groups when TV audio starts playing

enable.title: Sub
enable.description: Enable or disable deep low-frequency output to the bonded Sonos Sub

level.title: Sub Level
level.description: Adjust subwoofer output power and punch from -10 to +10

crossover.title: Crossover Frequency
crossover.description: Lower end is best for large floor speakers, higher end for compact speakers.

phase.title: Phase Control
phase.description: Align subwoofer speaker cone timing with main speakers (0° or 180°)

enable.title: Surrounds
enable.description: Enable or disable rear surround sound speakers in this room

tvLevel.title: TV Level
tvLevel.description: Adjust relative volume balance of rear surround speakers for TV from -15 to +15

musicLevel.title: Music Level
musicLevel.description: Adjust relative volume balance of rear surround speakers for music from -15 to +15

musicPlayback.title: Music Playback
musicPlayback.description: Set whether surrounds play subtle ambient accompaniment or full stereo sound for music

level.title: Height Level
level.description: Adjust the height channel audio level during playback of immersive audio formats.

language.title: Language
language.subtitle: Choose the language Remos Player uses

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: News and updates about Remos Player
notifications.emptySubtitle: Announcements about Remos Player will appear here.

update.title: Software Update
update.subtitle: Remos Player checks for new versions automatically
update.availableDetail: You have version {{version}}. Update from the Google Play Store.
update.upToDate: Remos Player is up to date
update.serverUnreachable: Couldn't reach the update server. Check your internet connection.

about.title: About
about.description: Browse, search and control your Sonos system with your TV remote. Remos Player talks to your speakers directly over your local network.
